1ae5ffc2-f43e-48da-961e-f1dd4a5359bb/Eve.en: "Wait, wait a moment.<NL>Dear Taiwu, I see the furrow on your brow and the worry on your face. It seems that this world has burdened you a lot.<NL>Ah, there are so many words I hope to say, but words alone cannot express the guilt I feel.<NL>Here, let me offer you a small gift. Please don't be mad at me, alright?"<NL><NL>One of the people of Wanqu approaches <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> with a look of guilt and remorse,<NL>then takes out two shiny objects from his pocket and hands them to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

Кажется, этот мир сильно обременял вас.<NL>Ах, есть так много слов, которые я надеюсь сказать, но одни только слова не могут выразить ту вину, которую я чувствую.<NL>Вот, позвольте мне предложить вам небольшой подарок. We will strive to make the world of Taiwu more and more enjoyable!"<NL>With these words, the people of Wanqu show a trace of shame on his face,<NL>then swiftly disappears from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s sight...
